course_name_en: Project Management for Software Development Projects
prerequisites: Competencies taught in the Software Engineering module are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: describe what constitutes a good project manager and what the success factors for good project management are
present classic project management topics that are important for the successful execution of large and small software projects in business
demonstrate the difference between classic and agile procedural models and contrast their areas of application
describe the tools of a project manager for planning and controlling, quality and risk management
estimate realistic efforts and know the framework conditions to be observed
name the personal competencies of a project manager that are necessary to lead a project to success
describe the legal framework conditions relevant for a project manager
describe project management patterns that fill a project manager's toolbox
be familiar with the various tools and be able to assess their effect in specific situations and typical problems

syllabus_topics: Agile Software Development Processes (e.g., Scrum, XP, etc.), Lego/Scrum Workshop
IT economics, effort estimation and effort planning
Contract forms and project management patterns

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To receive credit, at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and solutions for at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The final assessment is either an oral examination or a written examination. Grading is based on 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Business Informatics degree program.
